text: Content supports. Today a deliberate refrain is impossible: the corpus gate and the engine both treat any shared 5-gram in a book as a defect (check_collisions; DeterministicValidators). Writable without touching beat pools: a refrain is a separate per-blueprint line family (base x3 + changed ending x1), slot-free so no vowel-harmony risk, exempted from the collision check by tag. Cost is small (~40-60 short lines for 19 blueprints); the real cost is the engine/validator exemption, which is story-engine's call. Best fit is bedtime: the changed last refrain can carry the calm landing.
